claims.text: The Japanese-Vietnamese dataset consists of 106,758 pairs of sentences collected from TED talks extracted from WIT3's corpus.
The validation set used in the experiments is dev2010 and the test set is tst2010.
Data augmentation methods were applied to the Japanese-Vietnamese direction using Vietnamese monolingual data from VNESEcorpus.
